big_case.notes: Pro se paid petition from an Ohio intermediate appellate court over a single assignee's 2010 insurance claim, time-barred under S.B. 224's uncodified eight-year transition provision. The sole question (whether a published but uncodified session law gives due-process notice of a shortened limitations period) is conceded-reasonable-time on its own terms, cites no conflict beyond intra-Ohio dicta, drew no response, no amici, and no separate writing on denial. Stakes are confined to one party; the abstract notice theory has no realistic prospect of being reached.
